note: Frozen settings from REPRODUCTION_PLAN.md and the EXP-2026-001 card. Contains no patient identifiers; private manifests and splits live under data/.

data.unknown_mri_unit_policy: assume the mm unit of the matching label grid; record the assumption, never edit source headers

frame.z_extent: axis-aligned bounding box of the pre-op source field of view

intensity.foreground: voxels differing from the background: the border mode, accepted only if it covers min_border_fraction of the border and is the whole-volume mode

registration.acceptance_policy: PENDING: calibrate on training patients only and freeze before registering validation/test targets

fallbacks.preregistered: 2026-11-03, after the reference 256_scalar gate failed and before any fallback was run
fallbacks.upsampling: in-plane nearest neighbour x2: 512 px over the same field of view, 0.5 mm/px, 4 mm VAE stride
fallbacks.back_to_1mm: each 2x2 block takes its most frequent ID; ties go to the top-left pixel
fallbacks.class_rgb_decoding: strongest channel above 0.5 after denormalization; otherwise background; exact ties go to the higher ID
fallbacks.selection_rule: select the first variant in order that passes on every path; if none passes, report a representation failure
fallbacks.not_yet_gated: fixed pre-op crop + 512 px (plan section 8 fallback 3)

addendum_2026_11_03.reason: the three variants above failed (best: 512_class_rgb, Dice 0.859); the plan's fallback 3 (crop + 512 px) is added with the class-separated codec, before it was run; thresholds unchanged

crop192_512_class_rgb.crop_size_source: largest in-plane pre-op brain extent over the 24 accepted training patients (182 x 147 mm), rounded up to 192 mm; not chosen from any gate result
crop192_512_class_rgb.centre: centre of the in-plane bounding box of the patient's own pre-op foreground (all slices); pre-op only, inference-safe
crop192_512_class_rgb.forward: nearest neighbour: each crop pixel takes the 1 mm frame voxel containing its centre; outside the frame -> background
crop192_512_class_rgb.back_to_1mm: each 1 mm voxel takes the most frequent ID among the crop pixels whose centres fall in it; ties -> the pixel nearest the voxel centre (lower index if equidistant); voxels not covered by the crop -> background
crop192_512_class_rgb.coverage_rule: a patient whose pre-op foreground is not fully covered by the crop is flagged, and its excluded brain and reference-label voxels are reported; nothing outside the crop counts as preserved

representation.selected_on: 2026-11-03 by the preregistered fallback order (gate PASS on every path)
representation.image_forward: bilinear at crop-pixel centres; 0 outside the frame
representation.image_back_to_1mm: box average of the crop pixels whose centres fall in each voxel; uncovered voxels are NaN (missing, never background)
representation.image_rgb_to_gray: mean of the three decoded channels after clamping to [0, 1]
representation.labels_back_to_1mm: most frequent ID per voxel; ties go to the nearest pixel
representation.fixed: 2026-11-03, before any model output was scored

roi_support.rule: restrict R_p and S_p to observed registered target support; report the excluded fraction; NA above the cap; non-finite output inside stays NA
roi_support.amended: 2026-11-03, before any model scoring; user decision after training-only copy-control QC

stage4_overfit.purpose: sanity only: can the pipeline fit 16 training slices; no quality, generalization or clinical claim

patients.rule: training patients accepted by the frozen registration policy, ranked by exported ID-3 voxel count (positive) or ID-1 + ID-2 count (ID-3-negative), ties by patient ID; the first that can supply all four slices are used, skipped patients are recorded

generation.shifted_condition_control: slice k of patient i takes the pre-op conditions of slice k of patient i + 1 and keeps its own text; final checkpoint only

criteria.eval_loss: final < step 0 for the image and the mask stream
criteria.image_mae: final mean brain MAE < step-0 mean, < copy-control mean and < shifted-condition mean

stage4_overfit.decision: PASS if every check holds; otherwise ITERATE: record the failed checks, keep the slice set, rerun under a new run tag with one change declared before the rerun

stage4_r2_diagnostics.purpose: r2 repeats the r1 training unchanged (the one change: diagnostics on the trained model) to locate why generations ignore the pre-op inputs; oracle diagnostics use training targets and are never results
stage4_r2_diagnostics.training_and_standard_evaluation: identical to stage4_overfit; its checks are scored again to test reproducibility
stage4_r2_diagnostics.evaluated_model: the step-500 model, in the same session

leftover_signal.start: first DDIM timestep (981): add_noise(target latents, the same seeded noise as the pure-noise run)
leftover_signal.kept: own text and own pre-op inputs

metrics.added: whole-slice MAE; background MAE outside the pre-op brain; foreground Dice (intensity > threshold); own-target rank among the 16 by whole-slice MAE; nearest training mask by Dice of label > 0; share of generated labels inside the generated foreground

stage4_r2_diagnostics.decision: diagnostic only, no PASS; the readings pick the one training change for r3, declared before r3

stage4_r3_init_sources.purpose: separate the image-stream initialization sources before changing training: can available pre-op anatomy provide the spatial anchor that the oracle start provided in r2?
stage4_r3_init_sources.training_and_standard_evaluation: identical to stage4_overfit (third repeat); its checks are scored again
stage4_r3_init_sources.evaluated_model: the step-500 model, in the same session

image_stream_starts.own_postop: own post-op target latent; oracle diagnostic, never a result
image_stream_starts.own_preop: own pre-op latent (cached z_pre); available at inference
image_stream_starts.wrong_patient_preop: pre-op latent of the shifted-condition slice (another patient); negative control

stage4_r3_init_sources.kept_fixed: mask stream from pure noise; the same seeded noise, start timestep, own text and own concatenated pre-op conditions in every arm
stage4_r3_init_sources.reading_rules: preop anchor works: own-pre-op retrieval >= 12/16 and it closes >= half the whole-slice MAE gap between pure noise and the oracle start; patient-specific: its retrieval exceeds the wrong-patient arm's by >= 8
stage4_r3_init_sources.decision: diagnostic only, no PASS. preop_anchor_justified: a pre-op-initialized editing baseline becomes justified (declared as a new arm before use); only_future_target_rescues: stronger evidence that training must change; image_anchor_insufficient: the image start alone does not rescue generation

stage4_r4_pair_start.purpose: sampling-only test from the saved r3 step-500 weights: does starting the mask stream from the noised pre-op mask, together with the pre-op image, make the masks follow while the image anchor is kept?
stage4_r4_pair_start.weights: stage4/r3/unet_step000500.pt (the r3 step-500 UNet, saved after the r3 arms); loaded strictly, SHA256 recorded
stage4_r4_pair_start.slices: the stage4_overfit selection (the same 16 training slices)

arms.pure_noise: both streams from pure noise (r3 reference)
arms.image_own_preop: image from own pre-op latent, mask from pure noise (r3 replicate)
arms.pair_own_preop: image from own pre-op latent and mask from own pre-op mask latent (class-RGB codec, VAE posterior mean x scaling factor); available at inference
arms.pair_own_postop: own post-op image and mask latents; oracle diagnostic, never a result
arms.pair_wrong_patient_preop: pre-op image and mask latents of the shifted-condition slice (another patient); negative control

stage4_r4_pair_start.kept_fixed: the same seeded noise, start timestep, own text and own concatenated pre-op conditions in every arm; guidance 7.5, 50 DDIM steps
stage4_r4_pair_start.added_metrics: patient_top1 / mask_patient_top1: generations whose nearest target (whole-slice MAE) or nearest training mask belongs to the slice's own patient
stage4_r4_pair_start.decision: diagnostic only, no PASS. preop_pair_start_justified needs: the weights reproduce r3 (both reference arms within 0.005 whole-slice MAE); masks follow (mask_patient_top1 >= 14 and label-free labels <= 100 mm2 mean); the image anchor is kept (patient_top1 >= 14 and whole-slice MAE <= 1.25 x the image-only arm); the start is patient-specific (patient_top1 exceeds the wrong-patient arm by >= 6). Then the pre-op-pair start is declared as a Stage 5 sampling arm next to pure noise
